title: Draftstopping materials.
officialText:
In noncombustible construction, draftstopping shall be of noncombustible materi-
als. In combustible construction, draftstopping materials shall not be less than 1/2-inch (12.7 mm) gypsum board, 3/8-
inch (9.5 mm) wood structural panel, 3/8-inch (9.5 mm) particleboard, 1-inch (25 mm) nominal lumber, cement
fiberboard, batts or blankets of mineral wool or glass fiber, or other approved materials adequately supported. The
integrity of draft stops shall be maintained.
